name: Pure and Simple Poolcare LLC
services: Green-to-Clean algae treatment for neglected/green pools
Brush & Net service (for pools with automatic cleaners or screened enclosures)
Chemical-Only Plus (weekly water testing, chemical dosing, filter cleaning)
Full-service weekly maintenance (chemical balance, tile/wall brushing, skimming, professional Hammer-Head vacuum)

reviews.text: A reliable small business with a hard-working owner (Josh) who is very knowledgeable and will cater to all of your needs from pool-cleaning to diagnosing & fixing operational pool equipment issues.
reviews.author: Mark Vatter

reviews.text: I loved Pure and Simple Pool Care. As a new pool owner I had lots of question and Josh was patient and responsive... Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Donna Girard

reviews.text: Joshua...was very kind to help me with my problems with my pool, over the phone, even though he didn't have to... I highly recommend him.
reviews.author: Nene

source_notes: A real standalone website was found at pureandsimplepoolcare.com (GoDaddy site), contradicting the brief's 'Birdeye profile only' assumption -- it directly confirms phone, owner (Joshua Hildebrand, 'in the business since 2008'), address (1712 Ison Ln, Ocoee, FL 34761), email (pureandsimplepoolcare@gmail.com), services, and 3 review pull-quotes under 'What Our Neighbors Are Saying' (styled like an embedded Google Reviews widget, not attributed to a platform on-page). Owner is independently confirmed via the Yelp listing's owner-info blurb ('Joshua H.', Claimed status) and a LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/pureandsimplepoolcare, 'Owner at Pure and Simple Poolcare'). Service-area list merges two overlapping but non-identical self-statements: the website homepage ('Orlando, Ocoee, Windermere, Winter Garden, Winter Park, and Metro West') and the Yelp owner bio ('Windermere, Gotha, Metrowest, Ocoee, Winter Garden, Bay Hill, Dr. Phillips and surrounding areas'). A 4th website testimonial (Amanda Monday) was excluded -- it only showed Google review category tags (Responsiveness, Punctuality, etc.), not an actual quoted sentence. Facebook page (facebook.com/PureandSimplePoolcare, 184 likes, 2 check-ins) and an Instagram account were located but not scrapable (Facebook login wall). Most gallery images on the site are Getty stock photography (explicit 'GettyImages-*' filenames appear elsewhere on the same site) -- only the truck and technician-at-work photos listed here are judged likely to be the business's own.
